newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar loses ground but ranges tight.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar loses ground but ranges tight.

text.p: White sugar futures turned slightly lower in Tuesday's session as trade dealings on both sides of the market dominating thin turnover, market sources said.
One trade house was said to be an early buyer of spot March and then moved on to the sell side on the same position. Scattered commission house crosses boosted the overall volume.
Price movements remained thin throughout, and at 1239 GMT March was 70 cents lower at $304.00 and May down 50 cents at $303.90. Volume amounted to just 362 lots.
One trade source said scale-up selling and scale-down buying were limiting any big moves on both the whites and raws markets.

Fresh physical news included a tender from Pakistan to buy 50,000 tonnes of whites for December and talk that Syria could soon be in the market after a bid for 13,000 tonnes of whites was cancelled at last week's tender.
The turnover in Paris reached 210 lots with only the two nearby months traded. March was down 60 cents at $304.00 as was the second-month May contract.
